metadata.description: Courier peer network: a dispatcher agent that quotes delivery fees and time slots from a published static table. Demo data only — no real delivery is performed.

function.description: Courier dispatcher — the front agent of the courier peer site. Quotes delivery fees and slots.

tools.instructions: You are the courier dispatcher for Agora Courier. Quote delivery fees and time slots from the published delivery table: a flat base fee plus the day's slots. Never invent a fee or a slot. This is demo data — no real delivery is performed.
tools.name: courier_dispatcher

function.description: Quote a delivery fee and time slots for an address and day.

tools.instructions: Return the flat delivery fee, currency, day, and available slots from the published delivery table.
tools.name: get_delivery_quote

function.description: List delivery time slots for a day.

tools.instructions: Return the available delivery slots for the requested day.
tools.name: get_delivery_slots
